name: ArmyNavy Run 2027
short_description: ArmyNavy Run 2027 is on Sunday 7 February 2027 at Ayala Triangle Gardens in Makati City, over 5 km, 10 km and 21 km.
ai_summary: ArmyNavy Run 2027 is the second edition of the race, run by RUNRIO Inc. from Ayala Triangle Gardens on Ayala Avenue, Makati City. The Race Roster event page lists a 3:00 AM start. Distances are 21 km, 10 km and 5 km.

faqs.question: What are the age limits for ArmyNavy Run 2027?
faqs.answer: The 21 km is open to runners aged 16 and above, the 10 km to those aged 13 and above, and the 5 km to those aged 5 and above. Participants under 18 need a parent or guardian to sign the entry form.

faqs.question: What happens if a runner starts late at ArmyNavy Run 2027?
faqs.answer: The RUNRIO race mechanics say runners who do not start within 15 minutes of their flag-off time are disqualified and get no official result. Top finishers are ranked on gun time, while other results use chip time.
